Multiverse Computing and Qualcomm have teamed up to tune AI models for use on Qualcomm’s Dragonfly AI200 and AI250 accelerators, aiming to boost performance and efficiency on these custom chips. The partnership focuses on tailoring machine‑learning workloads to the hardware’s strengths and reducing inference time and energy consumption. Coverage of this collaboration has been compiled by Google News from multiple global outlets.
